explosionwand.jei.rift_core: Dropped in the chest of the Rift Heart's lair, the last hall of the Rift. Defeat the Heart to get the chest with the Core, the Rift Staff and the Seal Shard: Sleep.
explosionwand.jei.eclipse_heart: Dropped in the loot chest of the Eclipse King. The boss is summoned with the Eclipse Seal, which requires a Rift Core.
explosionwand.jei.dream_staff: Found in the loot chest of the Dream Monolith together with the Dreaming Eye. The Monolith is summoned with the Dreamer's Seal, crafted from an Eclipse Heart.
explosionwand.jei.dreaming_eye: Dropped in the loot chest of the Dream Monolith. Needed for the Sky Seal, which summons the Sky Whale.
explosionwand.jei.whale_staff: Found in the loot chest of the Sky Whale. Summon it with the Sky Seal, which requires a Dreaming Eye.
item.explosionwand.seal_shard_rift.desc: Held in hand, pulls toward the nearest Rift. Trembles and rings nearby. Unlocks its door.
explosionwand.shard.near: The shard trembles and rings: %s is very close
explosionwand.shard.silent: The shard is silent: no trace of the Seal here
explosionwand.dungeon.locked.rift: The crystal door is locked. Unlock it with the Seal Shard: Rift
explosionwand.dungeon.brazier_lit: Brazier lit: you will respawn here
explosionwand.dungeon.building: The walls are still being built here. Wait a moment
explosionwand.dungeon.cleared: Hall complete: a reward chest appeared
explosionwand.dungeon.peaceful: The dungeon sleeps in peaceful mode
explosionwand.dungeon.no_teleport: The dungeon walls refuse you: teleportation does not work
explosionwand.dungeon.no_wand: This wand is silent inside a dungeon
explosionwand.dungeon.solved: The mechanism clicks: a passage has opened somewhere
explosionwand.dungeon.lever: The lever is pulled: something shifts in the wall
explosionwand.dungeon.seal_shut: The door slams shut. There is no way back until the lair falls silent
explosionwand.mob.dreamer_cast: The Dreamweaver lulls you: leave the circle!
explosionwand.mob.cradler_chime: The Cradler swings the lantern: leave the chime range or take cover!
explosionwand.mob.cradler_lantern.sub: The chime is silenced, strike its body
explosionwand.mob.fog_steal: The Fog Walker stole your item: catch it!
explosionwand.mob.fog_escaped: The Fog Walker faded into the mist, leaving your item on the ground
item.explosionwand.rift_staff.desc1: Use: a crack that pulls mobs on its line and hurts them
item.explosionwand.rift_staff.desc2: Shift+Use: step through the rift, 8 blocks ahead
explosionwand.jei.rift_staff: Dropped in the loot chest of the Rift Heart, together with the Rift Core and the Seal Shard: Sleep.
item.explosionwand.sleep_seal_shard.desc: Leads to the nearest City of Sleepers while held. Trembles and rings when close. Unlocks its main gate.
explosionwand.jei.sleep_seal_shard: Dropped in the loot chest of the Rift Heart. Cannot be crafted.
explosionwand.dungeon.locked.sleep: The gate of the City of Sleepers is locked. Unlock it with the Seal Shard: Sleep
explosionwand.rift_staff.no_dungeon: The rift will not open into a dungeon
explosionwand.rift_staff.no_room: The rift leads nowhere: no room ahead
explosionwand.boss.rift.name: Rift Heart
explosionwand.boss.rift.shield.sub: Break the four crystals on the edge of the hall
explosionwand.boss.rift.shield.hint: The Heart is shielded! Break the 4 amethyst crystals on the pillars!
explosionwand.boss.rift.shield.broken: Shield broken! Strike while it is stunned!
explosionwand.boss.rift.rage.sub: Two beams and a ground slam
explosionwand.boss.rift.dead.sub: Loot is in the chest, the door is open
explosionwand.dungeon.locked.sleep_templ: The temple door is locked. Unlock it with the Temple Seal from the crypt
item.explosionwand.temple_seal.desc: Lies in a crypt under one of the houses of the City of Sleepers. Unlocks the temple door in the city centre.
explosionwand.jei.temple_seal: Found in the crypt chest of the City of Sleepers (the house under the moon sign). Cannot be crafted.
explosionwand.city.fog_warn: The fog is thickening. Do not stand still
explosionwand.city.fog_slow: Sleep creeps over you: your legs turn to lead
explosionwand.city.gate_closed: The gate is shut. You cannot enter the city without a Sleep Shard
